entities.name: Zayyanid Dynasty
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Zayyanid dynasty or Ziyanids or Abd al-Wadids was a Berber Zenata dynasty that ruled the Kingdom of Tlemcen, mainly in modern Algeria centered on the town of Tlemcen in northwest Algeria. The Zayyanid dynasty's rule lasted from 1235 to 1557.
